name: chlorzoxazone
warnings: WARNINGS Serious (including fatal) hepatocellular toxicity has been reported rarely in patients receiving chlorzoxazone. The mechanism is unknown but appears to be idiosyncratic and unpredictable. Factors predisposing patients to this rare event are not known. Patients should be instructed to report
contraindications: CONTRAINDICATIONS Chlorzoxazone is contraindicated in patients with known intolerance to the drug.
